thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: streaming-payload-tail-latency p99 breached (service=stream-api, env=prod)
incident-bot: Details: p99 >= 8.2s over the last 5m, error-rate stable, increased backpressure signals from proxies. Paging on-call.
Elena S: I'm on it. catching up to logs now. what's the customer impact?
James O: Oncall here. I'm seeing a rise in TCP retransmits between edge-proxy and stream-svc, and nginx upstream timed out messages.
Raja P: Noted. Observability shows p95 jumped from ~380ms to ~1.6s and p99 to 8s. Affected endpoints: /v1/stream and /v1/chat/stream (SSE + ws).
Olivia C: Customer-facing: a couple enterprise customers reported 'stalls' in streaming editor sessions. CS flagged two support tickets.
Ryan K: Rollouts? any recent deploys to stream-api or proxy config changes?
Elena S: There was a small proxy tweak earlier today to enable `tcp_nodelay` on upstreams and a canary to change chunking behavior for connection pooling.
James O: That can match symptoms — chunking change might cause clients to buffer until full chunk arrives. Also proxy timeout is still 30s.
Raja P: Can we confirm whether it's client backpressure vs proxy buffering? check `upstream_bytes_waiting` in proxy metrics.
Ryan K: Pulling proxy metrics...
infra-bot: Command executed: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/edge-proxy --since=10m | grep -i upstream timed out | wc -l` -> 42
Ryan K: `edge-proxy` shows a spike of `upstream timed out` and `write failed: connection reset by peer` around 2154320900-2154321100.
Elena S: I'm tailing stream service logs for stalls:
```
stream-service | 2026-03-14T10:08:23Z [warn] client-backpressure: write loop blocked for 7000ms
stream-service | 2026-03-14T10:08:31Z [info] chunk_emit duration=1100ms chunk_size=16KB conn=abcd
stream-service | 2026-03-14T10:09:05Z [error] kv-cache miss; reserialize
```
James O: Hmm chunk_emit duration > 1s for several connections. That's the tail behavior. Likely upstream stalls causing proxy buffers to grow and then client connections read slowly.
Raja P: Quick mitigation proposals: 1) Increase proxy upstream timeout from 30s -> 120s (reduce premature resets). 2) Temporarily disable the new chunking canary. 3) Force immediate flush on stream svc for SSE (set `flush_interval=50ms`). 4) Route critical customer traffic to standby instances not on the canary pool.
Olivia C: Prioritize customer-facing mitigation (3) and routing (4) — CS needs to update customers ASAP.
Ryan K: I can bump proxy timeout and reroute traffic. Doing a controlled change to avoid cascading.
Elena S: I'll push a config change to stream-service to enable `flush_interval=50ms` and disable internal batching for SSE endpoints.
James O: Before changes, let's capture a pcap of an affected connection for upstream analysis. `tcpdump -i eth0 port 443 -w /tmp/stream-stall.pcap`
infra-bot: Runbook note: On-call should add mitigation to incident timeline.
Ryan K: Changing edge-proxy config (rolling to 2 nodes first):
```
# new upstream config
upstream_timeout: 120s
max_buffer_size: 256k
```
Ryan K: Rolling to canary nodes now (step 1/3)
Elena S: Config push for stream-service:
```
# sse settings
stream.sse.flush_interval_ms=50
stream.sse.batch_enabled=false
```
Elena S: Pushing now to 2 pods (canary) then monitor.
Raja P: Observability hooks: watch p95/p99 + proxy queue depth + `edge_proxy.upstream_wait_ms`.
James O: Also toggling keepalives: enable `Connection: keep-alive` force on proxies to reduce handshake overhead for long-lived connections.
Olivia C: CS update draft: "We're aware of streaming stalls affecting a small subset of active streaming sessions. Engineers are mitigating with network and service configuration changes. We'll follow up in 30m with status and possible workarounds."
Elena S: Canary results: after enabling immediate flush and disabling batching, SSE chunk_emit durations dropped to ~50-200ms for canary pods.
infra-bot: Metric update: p95 down to 420ms on canary subset, p99 ~1.1s (from 8s).
Ryan K: Edge-proxy timeout rolled on 2/6 nodes, initial node shows reduced `upstream timed out`. Proceeding with full rollout.
James O: After full rollout, monitoring ingress queue depth — looks steady.
Raja P: Recalculate impact: affected traffic peaked at 3.4% of streaming requests; during breach, approx 270 requests/min experienced >5s stalls.
Olivia C: Notifying affected customers now. Adding suggested temporary workaround: reconnect session (client will fetch missing tokens) or switch to polling as fallback.
Elena S: Next steps: 1) Postmortem — root cause likely regression in chunking + proxy buffer interaction. 2) Reproduce in staging with same chunking config and long-tail consumer simulation. 3) Add stricter streaming e2e tests (simulate slow clients).
Ryan K: I'm going to create a deploy rollback ticket for the chunking canary and flag the change for revert if we see recurrence.
James O: Any signs of increased CPU/GPU impact? I saw no spike on inference nodes, so not resource exhaustion. This aligns with buffering/backpressure.
Elena S: Logging saved to `s3://redwood-incidents/2154321000/` (logs + pcap).
Olivia C: CS: sent interim message to affected customers. One asks for ETA — suggest 60-90m to confirm full mitigation and follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident severity set to P2. Owners: oncall=James O, svc=Elena S, infra=Ryan K.
Raja P: I'll draft the postmortem template and assign follow-ups.
James O: Marking this thread for handoff to next oncall at 2154325200. If anything reappears escalate to P1.
Elena S: Good run. will continue monitoring for 30m then start RCA steps.
Olivia C: Thanks team. updating tickets and CS notes now. :thumbsup:
